product.title: Primul Război Mondial. Războiul care urma să pună capăt tuturor războaielor
product.description: După o sută de ani, Primul Război Mondial continuă să ne fascineze şi să ne îngrozească. Acest volum, cu o prefaţă de profesorul Hew Strachan, scris de trei istorici de renume, cuprinde luptele de pe toate teatrele de război şi investighează câteva dintre poveştile neistorisite ale conflictului. Studiază umilirea Rusiei la Tannenberg, în timp ce marile bătălii de pe frontul de vest – de pe Somme, de la Ypres, de la Verdun, din pădurea Belleau – şi memorabilele campanii din Palestina, Italia şi Africa sunt explorate prin raportarea la cauzele lor şi la fundalul războiului. Noua tehnologie şi tactică adoptate în urma stagnării de pe linia frontului, care a dus la crearea a sute de kilometri de tranşee, sunt dezvăluite şi cercetate, autorii explorând în paralel vieţile civililor şi soldaţilor prinşi în conflictul armat, pe baza unor relatări din sursă directă, care oferă o imagine emoţionantă şi prezintă particularităţile personale a fiecărei biografii în peisajul ororilor Marelui Război.

# World War I: The Conflict That Changed Everything

**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Non-Fiction History

Explore one of history's most defining periods with **World War I. The War That Was Supposed to End All Wars**. This comprehensive volume offers an unparalleled deep dive into the Great War, examining not only the massive battles and technological shifts but also the human stories that defined a global conflict.

For readers fascinated by the causes, chaos, and lasting impact of World War One, this book is an essential read. It moves beyond simple battle accounts to offer a nuanced, scholarly view of the entire devastating period.

## A Global Look at the Great War

The enduring fascination and horror surrounding the First World War are masterfully captured within these pages. This volume brings together insights from three renowned historians, supported by a foreword from Professor Hew Strachan, ensuring readers receive an academically rich and engaging narrative.

The book meticulously covers conflicts across every major theater of war:

*   **Western Front Battles:** Detailed accounts of pivotal engagements such as the Somme, Ypres, Verdun, and the battlefields of Belleau Wood.
*   **Global Campaigns:** Exploration of remarkable campaigns in Palestine, Italy, and Africa.
*   **Military Focus:** An investigation into key turning points, including the humiliation of Russia at Tannenberg.

## Uncovering Human Stories and Modern Warfare

The authors do not just chronicle battles; they explore the underlying causes and deep background of the war itself. The narrative successfully blends military history with deeply personal human experience:

*   **Technology and Tactics:** Discover how technological advancements and tactical stagnation led to the creation of hundreds of kilometers of trenches, fundamentally changing warfare forever.
*   **Civilian Experience:** Drawing on direct source reports, the book gives voice to the civilians and soldiers caught in the conflict. Each biography presented offers a poignant and emotional portrait against the backdrop of wartime horrors, providing a unique perspective often missing from traditional military histories.

This comprehensive approach ensures that readers gain both an understanding of grand strategy *and* the intimate details of individual lives during this monumental era.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Is this book focused only on the Western Front?**
No. While major battles like those at the Somme and Ypres are covered, the volume takes a global approach, including campaigns in Palestine, Italy, and Africa.

**Who is this book best for?**
This book is ideal for history enthusiasts, students, and readers who appreciate detailed, scholarly non-fiction about 20th-century military conflicts and their socio-political impacts.
